authors: Hongyoon Kim; Eunwoo Park; Jeongwoo Park; Dong Kyo Oh; Jehyeon Shin; Hyeonsu Heo; Chulhong Kim; Junsuk Rho

summary_en: Introduces an electrically switchable dual-focus metalens-based photoacoustic microscopy system that changes focal depth through polarization control rather than mechanical focus translation. The system provides depth-extended in vivo ophthalmic vascular imaging and directly combines flat-optics design with photoacoustic detection, making it strongly relevant to acoustic-optics imaging.
publication_note: Published September 4, 2026 in Light: Science & Applications, volume 15, article 369.
